cases.name: blog_post_target_filter
cases.expected: only Comments lifecycle events whose target_type is blog_post are projected

cases.name: envelope_idempotency
cases.expected: the event envelope id is the delivery-ledger primary key and an existing delivery is acknowledged without another counter update

cases.name: atomic_counter_delivery_outbox
cases.expected: the row-locked derived counter update, delivery insert, and neutral Blog reindex request share one database transaction

cases.name: missing_post_retry
cases.expected: a missing tenant post returns before any delivery marker or outbox record is committed so the event can retry

cases.name: non_negative_count
cases.expected: the state-based counter transition floors deletes at zero and saturates comment_count without changing the Blog business revision

cases.name: host_registration_routing_harness
cases.expected: the retained module test invokes BlogModule::register_event_listeners, extracts one blog_comment_projection handler, accepts Blog comment created/updated/status_changed/deleted events, and rejects a non-Blog target

cases.name: postgres_event_dispatcher_delivery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL dispatcher case registers the Blog handler through BlogModule, publishes one envelope through EventBus and EventDispatcher, then expects the counter, delivery ledger, and outbox row to commit

cases.name: postgres_concurrent_unique_deliveries
cases.expected: four handler instances start behind one barrier on four independent PostgreSQL connections, deliver unique envelopes to one post, and require count four, unchanged business version one, four ledger rows, and four reindex outbox rows without claiming observed retry count

cases.name: postgres_duplicate_delivery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target replays one envelope id and expects one counter transition, one delivery row, and one outbox row

cases.name: postgres_out_of_order_delete_create
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target delivers delete before create and expects a non-negative count while the Blog business version remains unchanged

cases.name: postgres_missing_post_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target expects no delivery or outbox commit while the post is missing, then replays the same envelope after source creation

cases.name: postgres_outbox_rollback_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target removes the outbox table, expects counter and delivery rollback, recreates the table, and replays the same envelope

cases.name: postgres_restart_replay
cases.expected: the retained restart target opens a new database connection and handler over the same schema, replays the same envelope, and expects one durable application

cases.name: postgres_process_restart_replay
cases.expected: the retained process target launches the integration-test executable twice in sequence, reconstructs the same envelope id in each child process, and expects one counter transition, one delivery row, and one outbox row

cases.name: module_listener_registration
cases.expected: Blog registers BlogCommentProjectionHandler through the module event-listener registry

cases.name: comment_lifecycle_ordering
cases.expected: per-comment lifecycle state is ordered by EventEnvelope id so out-of-order create/delete delivery converges without depending on global event ordering

cases.name: tenant_scoped_row_lock
cases.expected: the projection locks the tenant-scoped Blog post before reading the per-comment delivery state, serializing competing events for one post without using Blog business version as the projection token

cases.name: updated_event_advances_projection_cursor
cases.expected: a processed comment.updated event advances the Blog lifecycle delivery cursor without changing comment_count

cases.name: status_changed_event_advances_projection_cursor
cases.expected: a processed comment.status_changed event advances the Blog lifecycle delivery cursor and changes count only when active/deleted state changes

cases.name: update_and_status_lifecycle_delivery
cases.expected: comment.updated and comment.status_changed deliveries advance the durable tenant/post cursor without changing comment_count for an already active comment

cases.name: public_snapshot_cursor_invalidation
cases.expected: the processed tenant/post lifecycle cursor is part of the snapshot identity and therefore invalidates earlier snapshot keys without cache enumeration

runtime_promotion_requirements: execute cargo test -p rustok-blog --lib services::comment_projection::tests and retain classifier, state-based lifecycle ordering, counter, and unchanged-business-revision output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL dispatcher case and retain EventBus/EventDispatcher delivery output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL concurrency case and retain four-connection convergence output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL comment_projection_postgres_test target and retain duplicate, out-of-order, missing-post, and rollback/retry output
execute the env-gated same-process restart case and retain its output
execute the env-gated process-restart case and retain both child-process exits plus final durable assertions
retain proof that duplicate and out-of-order comment.created/comment.deleted deliveries match the state-based projection contract
retain proof that the counter, delivery ledger, and neutral Blog reindex outbox row commit or roll back together
retain missing-post retry and later recovery evidence
retain that concurrent unique deliveries converge under the Blog post row lock without changing the business version
retain full server-host restart recovery evidence separately from the test-process harness
